tbesh_html:
Sirion = "breastplate"
one of the names of Mount Hermon this one used by the Sidonians
Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon
strongs_1890.derivation: and שִׂרְיֹן; the same as H8304 (שְׂרָיָה) (i.e. sheeted with snow);
